sources.citation: Martius, Carl Friedrich Phil. von. 1867. Beiträge zur Ethnographie und Sprachenkunde Amerika's zumal Brasiliens. II: Wörtersammlung brasilianischer Sprachen / Glossaria linguarum brasiliensium. Leipzig: Fleischer. 'Jumana' pp. 250-252.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Latin-glossed wordlist (Martius at Maripi, Spix at Caiçara) with sporadic acute accents on forms; footnote p.250 only names the collectors and notes affinities to Moxa, Maypure, Marauha. General orthography note (pp. 28-30, written for Tupi) says the acute 'dient, den Vocal zu schärfen oder die Sylbe zu betonen' — a transcription convention, not a stress rule for Jumana.
